note.zh-TW: 本課故事的所得稅金額是課程的教學設定，與法定稅率不符時，網站會提示這一點。
note.en: The tax amount in the course story is a teaching assumption; when the effective rate differs from the statutory rate, the site points this out.

definition.zh-TW:
把本期的所得稅費用拿來和稅前淨利相比得到的百分比，也就是公司每賺一元稅前利潤，實際上有多少被所得稅拿走。

它常和法定稅率不一樣，因為有免稅所得、不可扣除的費用以及以前年度的虧損扣抵等因素。
definition.en:
Income tax expense divided by profit before tax: for each unit of pre-tax profit, how much is actually taken by income tax.

It often differs from the statutory rate because of tax-exempt income, non-deductible expenses and losses carried forward.

example.zh-TW: 兩個數字都在損益表最下面幾列。稅前淨利為 0 時顯示 N/A，為負時比率不具解釋意義。本課故事的所得稅金額是課程的教學設定，所以算出來的有效稅率和法定稅率不符，實驗室會提示這一點。
example.en: Both figures are in the last few lines of the income statement. When profit before tax is zero the result is N/A; when it is negative the ratio is not meaningful. The tax amount in the course story is a teaching assumption, so the effective rate it produces does not match the statutory rate, and the lab points this out.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為有效稅率一定等於法定稅率。法定稅率是法律規定的名目稅率，有效稅率是用報表數字算出來的實際負擔，兩者相差越大，表示稅務調整的影響越大。
misconception.en: Expecting the effective rate to equal the statutory rate. The statutory rate is the nominal rate set by law; the effective rate is the actual burden computed from the statements, and a wide gap signals large tax adjustments.

formula.zh-TW: 有效稅率的算法：所得稅費用 ÷ 稅前淨利，看稅前賺到的錢有幾成繳了稅。
formula.en: Effective tax rate = income tax expense ÷ profit before tax.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
